content.title: Implement: usersRegenerate token override
content.description: Implement the agreed API change in usersRegenerate (packages/library/src/core/tracker.ts). Per the agreed design: either add { token } option forwarding into resolveAuthor, or relax the self-service check in open mode. Backward-compatible — existing callers unaffected. Add/update unit tests.

content.content:
Blocked by mqe274wi48 (Verify design agreed). Reassigning to manager.

Context to help resolve the blocker quickly: from my investigation the design already appears agreed. The CTO review (mqe1imi4lg) is 'done' with an ACCEPT decision and a specific, documented recommendation: add a backward-compatible `usersRegenerate(name, { token })` that forwards into `resolveAuthor({ token })`, since resolveAuthor already supports `options.token` but usersRegenerate does not expose it. No alternative design was requested. If you confirm, please mark mqe274wi48 resolved and reassign this to me so I can implement.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqe274wi48 transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Implemented the agreed backward-compatible token override for `usersRegenerate`.

**What changed (library API):**
- `Tracker.usersRegenerate(name, params?)` now accepts an optional `{ token?: string }` argument and forwards it into `resolveAuthor({ token })` (which already supported the option). This is the root-cause fix for BUG-1: in open-auth mode a registered user can now pass their token explicitly to prove identity, instead of the call silently authenticating as the default "anonymous" user and failing the self-service check with `INVALID_TOKEN`.
- Existing callers are unaffected — the new param is optional and the env-var fallback (`AGT_USER_TOKEN`) still works as before.

**Files touched (packages/library):**
- `src/core/tracker.ts` — new optional param + JSDoc + conditional token forwarding.
- `src/types/api.ts` — added exported `UsersRegenerateParams` interface.
- `src/types/index.ts` and `src/index.ts` — re-exported the new type so it's part of the public API.

**Quality gates:**
- `bun run typecheck` — clean.
- `bun run lint` — clean.
- `bun run test` — 954 pass / 5 fail. I verified (by stashing my changes and re-running) that the 5 failures are **pre-existing** and unrelated to this change — they live in the mentions suite (`extractMentions`/`rebuildMentionsIndex`/`mentionsRead`/`mentionsUnread` spec-deviation tests). All user/regenerate tests (22 in `tracker-users.test.ts` + `e2e/users.test.ts`) pass.

**Note on tests:** Per my role I do not author tests; the new `{ token }` override path needs unit/integration coverage — recommend assigning that to the test agent. Also worth flagging for the webapp-developer: the webapp Phase 4 e2e suite reportedly asserts the BUG-1 401 behavior of `usersRegenerate`; now that the library forwards the token that assertion may need updating once the webapp/CLI is wired to pass the token through.
